trajectory_summary: Call starts warm and stays warm — an unusually self-qualifying, technically engaged customer who supplies his own motivation, budget threshold, and roof detail with minimal prompting. Randy holds scope discipline well on two closer-tier questions but leaves the customer's own bill-anchor and stated reason under-leveraged, coasting on customer energy rather than actively building it. Outcome lands as a booked appointment on customer-initiated terms.

observed_outcome.reasoning: Customer confirms Thursday morning 9AM mountain time explicitly, and rep restates it back at 09:59 ('we'll give you a call Thursday at, 9AM'), locking day and time on both sides. Co-owner was identified at 03:02-03:09 but never confirmed for the appointment itself.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Rep acknowledged the bill ('Oh, jeez. Wow. Yeah. That's definitely pretty high.' at 04:07) but never turned it into a reason-to-act line; the flip should have landed right after 04:22 when the customer himself framed the cost-comparison threshold.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Customer's stated reason (full off-grid conversion, 01:26) was never echoed back during booking or button-up; the close used generic language about 'pricing warranties and savings' instead.
